claims.text: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was +2.0 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -2.8 to +6.7). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.

Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was +2.2 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -1.7 to +6.1). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
There were 0 sale days and 0 discount days during the window.
Off-topic negative reviews fell by 0.62 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline.
The decomposition of change showed a composition effect of -0.14.
The overall positive review share in the window was 95.68 percent compared to 94.83 percent in the baseline.

report.summary: The overall positive review share was 95.68 percent compared to 94.83 percent in the baseline. Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was +2.0 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch, and over the 7 days from the patch, it was +2.2 points. There were 0 sale days and 0 discount days during the window. Off-topic negative reviews fell by 0.62 percentage points, and the composition effect was -0.14. Noise or seasonality is supported, the patch and a price change or sale are inconclusive, and off-topic reviews or a review bomb and a change in who reviewed are rejected.
